name: Sybil Tanner
memories: I was in Redmarch when it happened. The land around Redmarch slowly recovers.
Word came from Rainhold: The Tanner family loads a cart and leaves Rainhold for Crowhold.
They say in the market: Famine in Goldrock and Gildport.
They say in the market: Gildport is starving, and the hunger reaches its neighbours.
They say in the market: The fields round Stonefell, Eaglehaven, Crowford and 1 more give out: sown too many years running, they bear thin and weedy, and will for a while yet.
They say in the market: House Thornvale storms Eaglehaven, tearing it from House Goldcrest.
